angle: constructor parameter type widening: sets.Set[DeviceID] → AllocatedState struct — single external call site
difficulty_notes: Models must trace which files call incubating.NewAllocator() directly (not through the public structured.NewAllocator wrapper). The incubating package is internal — it is not imported by plugin code, kubelet, or API server. The only direct caller is structured/allocator.go. Models will overestimate the blast radius, hallucinating that any DRA-related file that allocates devices must call NewAllocator. The correct answer is exactly one file.
